purpose: Discharge WAVE2_DISPOSITION's open 'CROSS_SITE_REPLAY_IF_AVAILABLE' for ORION-25: replay the frozen chained-attestation V2 generator and the trust-domain-law sweep on a second site and compare scientific endpoints by parsed-object equality through one code path.
custody_boundary: The second site (billy-old) is under the SAME programme custody. A green replay is portability evidence only: it is NOT independent replication, does NOT create a second custodian, and does NOT lift the trust-domain-law promotion block. scientific_authority_delta: NONE.

attestation_v2.reference_provenance: CI artifact 9500055966 of run 32665597624, member sha equal to the bound value in P15_ATTESTATION_COMPOSITION_RESULT_RECEIPT_V2_RUN2.md
attestation_v2.projection: delete observed_environment and receipt_sha256; compare remaining receipt as parsed objects

trust_domain_law.projection: whole object equality (result carries no environment fields)

planted_control: one byte flipped in a COPY of the workload receipts must change the attestation endpoint (or fail the runner) through the SAME projection-comparison path; if it does not fire, the run terminal is CANNOT_CHECK__CONTROL_FAILURE and nothing observed is evidence

terminal_semantics.T1_CROSS_SITE_ENDPOINTS_IDENTICAL: both endpoint objects reproduce exactly on the second site across a different OS/python/cryptography stack; portability established, custody boundary unchanged
terminal_semantics.T2_ENDPOINT_DIVERGENCE: at least one endpoint differs; the diverging keys are preserved verbatim and the affected result is flagged for root-cause before any further use
terminal_semantics.CANNOT_CHECK__CONTROL_FAILURE: the planted violation did not fire; nothing observed is evidence
terminal_semantics.CANNOT_CHECK__BINDING_DRIFT: an input no longer matches its frozen hash; the replay never ran

execution_plan.outputs: experiments/cross-site-replay-v1/RESULT_V1.json committed strictly after this design commit
